Cohorts in window: 1993 (CT), 1994 (AR), 1995 (AZ, CA, MO), 1996 (MN), 2007 (OR), 2010 (RI); 19 states treated from 1990 (always treated, incl. IL adopting in 1990); 23 never treated.
